title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
Seashore offering a seashell

Main Subject:
A knee-up portrait of a young woman kneeling on the sand at the edge of a transparent sea, wearing a white ruffled bikini with a blue floral pattern, offering a palm with a conch shell to the camera. The hand and shell in the left foreground are very large, showing the face in the center and the sea and reefs in the background.

Person/Expression:
A rounded oval face with a small chin, tilted slightly to the left. Large almond-shaped eyes of pale grey-brown, thin loose eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose and a small tip, and a gentle smile with closed glossy pale pink lips. Fair skin with pink cheeks and modest makeup. Long dark brown hair in a braided half-updo, with thin bangs and wet strands flowing to the cheeks and chest, and a single large white flower pinned to the left ear side.

Clothing/Pose:
A triangle bikini with small pale blue flowers on a white background. Thin neck straps, waving white ruffles on the chest, a long bow in the center, and thin ties at the hips. Sitting on the sand with both knees open, stretching her right arm straight to the front left of the screen. Palm open upward, carrying a small conch shell with peach-white spots. Her left hand is on the sand at the bottom right to support her body.

Background/Light:
The foreground is bright sand containing white shell fragments. From the left to the center is a transparent turquoise shallow sea and small waves, with grey reefs and greenery in the back right. The top is a vibrant blue sky with white cumulus clouds. Harsh direct sunlight from the upper left brightly illuminates the face, shoulders, chest, thighs, and palms.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The camera is at eye level with the kneeling person, capturing from the sky above the head to mid-knee. The outstretched hand is placed as a large foreground from the bottom left to the center, with the shell and fingers softly blurred by distance. The face is centered in the upper third, with a sharp focus on the eyes.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photo based on white, pale blue, turquoise, and pink. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, floral patterns and ruffles, wet hair, shell spots, sand grains, and transparent waves.

Negative:
Do not make the foreground hand and conch shell small; do not remove the shell from the palm.
